ps.brief: Puzzle 1, Vaulter: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Checks first: always scan for a check before anything else.

ps.brief: Puzzle 2, Vaulter: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: On an open board the Vaulter reaches checking squares from far away.

ps.brief: Puzzle 3, Vaulter: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Count the lines into the King; the Vaulter needs only one.

ps.brief: Puzzle 4, Vaulter: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: A check also takes away the opponent's choices.

ps.brief: Puzzle 5, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Safe captures only: make sure nothing can take back.

ps.brief: Puzzle 6, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: In a crowded position, check who defends the piece before grabbing it.

ps.brief: Puzzle 7, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: A capture that loses your Vaulter is not a win. Count attackers and defenders.

ps.brief: Puzzle 8, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for the undefended piece; that's free material.

ps.brief: Puzzle 9, Vaulter: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Use the Vaulter's special trait: that's what makes it unique.

ps.brief: Puzzle 10, Vaulter: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: The Vaulter's trait lets it do what ordinary pieces can't.

ps.brief: Puzzle 11, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Special moves create surprise; the opponent rarely sees them coming.

ps.brief: Puzzle 12, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Remember the Vaulter's trait in every position, not just the opening.

ps.brief: Puzzle 13, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Fork: one move, two targets. The Vaulter hits the King and a valuable piece at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 14, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: When the King is in check it must escape, so the second target falls.

ps.brief: Puzzle 15, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Double attacks win material even against careful defence.

ps.brief: Puzzle 16, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for a square that attacks two things at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 17, Vaulter: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Take the King in two: first remove every escape square, then strike.

ps.brief: Puzzle 18, Vaulter: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Pieces in front of their own King often become a trap.

ps.brief: Puzzle 19, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Calculate the whole line: the Vaulter wins material at the end.

ps.brief: Puzzle 20, Vaulter: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Forcing moves first, captures last.
